title: Jeff 1 / jev_clf — local open-source Jev-1.13.0 replacement

inspired_by.pattern: benchmark table + protocol footnotes + retractions with tells

benchmark.task: Given a claim and evidence passages, return a calibrated distribution over supported | refuted | not_enough_info.

official_score.authority: none — TypeSafe has not published a score on these splits
official_score.note: EVERY Jev number in this record is OUR re-measurement of hosted Jev 1.13.0 on OUR rows. None of it is comparable to any TypeSafe-published figure.

val_n199.naming_trap: Both release docs originally called this split='test'. It is split='val'. ground_truth.jsonl holds 1589 train / 199 val / 199 test; the 199 split='test' rows are a SEPARATE holdout that was never scored here.

test_n199.note: A THIRD, separate sealed holdout — not the rows in the val table. The server's GET /v1/models reports it as accuracy.test_n199=0.794 and calibration.ece_test_n199=0.063; both are backed by results/lm_eval_4b_multi_test.json (model ...+lora_4b_multi, split='test', n=199, acc 0.7939698492462312, ece 0.06343564570848664). Do not conflate these three 199-row splits.

gate_deviations.reason: val n=199 bootstrap 95% CI is +/-5.6 accuracy points (+/-11 rows), ~7x wider than scale's +/-0.75. Paired McNemar on val: 17 discordant for us, 14 against, z=0.54, p=0.59 — not significant. val and scale DISAGREE on the direction of a 'supported' bias (+2 val rows, -9 scale rows). val is a smoke test only.

flagged_runs.artifact: results/calibration_plot.png and results/static/calibration_plot.png, plus the demo page and GET /v1/models
flagged_runs.what_it_looked_like: Jev better calibrated than Jeff 1 on scale: Jev ECE 0.0790 vs ours 0.0807
flagged_runs.tell: Jev's stored 'confidence' field is NOT max(class probability) — measured to differ by up to 0.33, mean 0.040 on the 9730-row set (0.052 on val). The figure drew its ECE bars from that stored field while drawing its reliability curve from max(prob), so the legend contradicted its own curve.
flagged_runs.control: Recompute BOTH models from raw per-row predictions under one definition. Ours 0.08075, Jev 0.09321 — Jeff 1 is the better-calibrated model like-for-like.
flagged_runs.adopted_rule: One confidence definition per comparison. Jev's self-reported 0.0790 may be mentioned only with the note that it is not comparable to our 0.0807.
flagged_runs.second_tell: The same audit found stale figures on the demo page and /v1/models (accuracy 0.8174 -> 0.8183, ECE 0.0805 -> 0.0807), and a wrong split label (val described as split='test').

closed_levers.detail: Mechanism: a multiplicative bias on the posterior shifts the decision boundary but cannot fix confidently-wrong rows. Swept b=-0.6..+0.6 on the saved scale preds: identity (b=0) is optimal at 0.8183; every non-zero bias is worse. A bias tuned on val gains +2 rows there and LOSES 9 on scale — the two splits disagree, so val-only tuning is overfitting a 199-row smoke test.

Mechanism: NEI mass exists but is not discriminative AT the margin. Sweep t=0.05..0.96 predicting NEI whenever P(NEI)>=t: best gain is 2 rows (0.8183->0.8185 at t=0.46). NEI ranking AUC is 0.8865, so the signal is real — but 740 of 2106 gold-NEI rows already have NEI as runner-up, and the rows a threshold would flip are currently correct, so the cut trades wins for losses.
Mechanism: averaging 8 instruction wordings mixes incompatible first-token posteriors instead of reducing variance. Measured -3 rows and agreement-with-Jev collapsed 0.769 -> 0.374.

Mechanism: teacher noise is not the binding constraint, so reweighting the human subset changes the LM loss without moving the decision boundary. 3x ground_truth vs 1x jev: val LM loss improved, task accuracy fell 1 row.

Mechanism: a 0.5/0.5 weight-space merge of two adapters trained on different task mixtures interpolates in weight space with no guarantee either skill survives. scripts/jeff_merge.py writes artifacts/jev_clf/lora_merged; it was never evaluated, so shipping it would be an un-gated accuracy claim. Closed on absence of a gate.

Mechanism: bf16 batched GEMM reduces in a different order, so results are not bit-reproducible. Measured 4.43x speedup (2159ms -> 488ms per question) but first-token deltas up to 4.2e-03, enough to flip borderline rows. Usable as an opt-in demo accelerator only; never in the scored path.

conjunction.reading: We are NOT generally over-claiming. We pass the falsified-conjunct arm and the both-halves-true control, and fail only where the claim runs past the evidence: a conjunct with no evidence (we say 'supported' 0.67-0.72; Jev says not_enough_info 0.99) or a claim that overstates a measured number (we say 'supported' 0.83-0.91; Jev says refuted 0.87-1.00).

granularity.reading: Text held constant, only passage chunking varied. The failure is a confidence INSTABILITY as much as an accuracy error: Jev answers at 0.99-1.00 exactly where we answer wrong at 0.5-0.95.

jaggedness.miss: jag-count-2, gold refuted, answered not_enough_info at 0.639

gap_analysis.headline: The entire scale gap is not_enough_info recall on single-passage rows.

oracle_if_recall_matched_cell_by_cell.note: would put us ~+214 rows AHEAD of Jev; fixing NEI alone wins rather than ties

harness.local_loop: omp autoresearch on the jev_clf repo (delegating autoresearch.sh in the session repo)
harness.readout: jev_clf/readout.py — first_token iff all labels have distinct first tokens, else whole-sequence

soft_target_distill.mechanism: masked_lm_loss was hard-label token CE only, so the teacher's full distribution — present on all 12119 rows and hedging on 32.7% of NEI rows — was hardened to its argmax and discarded. Now CE + w*mean KL(teacher||student).
soft_target_distill.gate: soft term switches off for label spaces whose first tokens are not distinct (the 1800 score rows share token 220), mirroring readout.py. Measured 10319/12119 rows carry a usable soft target — exactly 12119-1800.
soft_target_distill.backward_compat: soft_target_weight defaults to 0.0, so configs without the key train exactly as before.

do_not: equate any Jev number here with a TypeSafe-published score — we re-measured Jev 1.13.0 on our own rows
quote Jev ECE 0.0790 as beating ours 0.0807 — retracted; like-for-like max(prob) is 0.0932 vs 0.0807 in our favour
quote the val split (0.7839 vs 0.7688) as a lead — 3 rows of 199, McNemar p=0.59; val is a smoke test and disagrees with scale on fix direction
treat val 0.7839 (lora_4b) and scale 0.8183 (lora_4b_multi) as the same adapter
cite README.md's 1.5B / 0.759 as Jeff 1 — stale generation, superseded by the release docs
present lora_merged as a measured Jeff 1 arm — it was never evaluated
call the sealed val holdout split='test' — it is split='val'
re-run the closed levers without new mechanism-level evidence
quote the batching speedup as free — it changes first-token values by up to 4e-03
